name: Hatibagan Sarbojonin
description:
Every year they make wonderful themes.
The year 2025's theme was, "Atho Ghat Kotha, which celebrates Kolkata's forgotten ghats, once vibrant epicenters of civic, cultural, and spiritual life along the Hooghly. From theatre rehearsals, wrestling matches, and political gatherings to the immersion of clay idols and sacred rituals like Nabapatrika bathing, these ghats bore witness to love, farewells, and devotion. Now largely absent from public memory, they remain silent sentinels of Bengal's history and traditions. This Durga Puja presentation evokes the untold stories and layered histories embedded in their steps, inviting visitors to experience the poetic rhythm of the river, heritage, and ritual, where the ghats themselves become portals to forgotten narratives."
French artist Thomas Henriot has collaborated with Bengali artist Tapas Datta to produce a remarkable 22ftx7ft artwork, which uniquely blends art, culture, and history, by depicting the ghats of the Ganga river at Hatibagan Sarbojanin pandal.

name: Jagat Mukherjee Park
description:

description:
Kumartuli Park Durgotsab is one of the most renowned and artistically distinguished pujas in North Kolkata. Situated in the cultural heart of Kumartuli — the hub of Bengal’s idol makers — this puja beautifully captures the essence of art, devotion, and heritage.

Each year, the club presents breathtaking themes that seamlessly combine tradition with modern creativity. The pandal design, lighting arrangements, and Durga idol are always crafted with exceptional detail and aesthetic appeal, reflecting the unmatched skill of local artisans.

The ambience is vibrant yet well-organized, with efficient crowd management and safety arrangements ensuring a comfortable experience for visitors. The cultural programs and festive atmosphere make it a highlight of the Durga Puja season.

Overall, Kumartuli Park Durgotsab continues to set high standards of creativity and devotion, making it a must-visit destination during Kolkata’s grand Durga Puja celebrations.

name: Darjipara sarbojanin Durgotsab
description:
One of the most spectacular pandals of North Kolkata this year! The entire theme is a tribute to the genius of Satyajit Ray — from movie posters and character installations to artistic recreations of his works. The entry tunnel, vintage set designs, and cinematic props bring alive the golden era of Bengali cinema.

The pandal itself is breathtaking — a mix of retro architecture, hanging chandeliers, intricate artwork, and Ray’s characters recreated in lifelike style. The idol of Maa Durga stands majestically in black with a blue-lit backdrop, surrounded by hundreds of miniature colorful houses, creating a powerful and modern visual impact.

Lighting and presentation are truly cinematic, making you feel like you’ve stepped into one of Ray’s movie sets. The experience is immersive, detailed, and deeply nostalgic. A must-visit pandal for both Puja enthusiasts and lovers of Bengali culture!

name: Kashi Bose Lane Durga Puja Committee
description:
An Artistic Triumph in the Heart of North Kolkata
Kashi Bose Lane Durga Puja Committee has once again proven why it remains an essential destination for pandal hoppers. This year's celebration is a masterful blend of profound artistic vision and deep-rooted tradition, creating an experience that is both visually stunning and emotionally resonant.
Nestled in the charming lanes of North Kolkata, the pandal transforms the entire locality into a living art installation. The theme is executed with exceptional creativity and an incredible eye for detail, utilizing unique materials and concepts that captivate from the very first glance. It’s a thoughtful and immersive experience that encourages you to pause and appreciate the craftsmanship.
The pratima (idol) is the heart of the setup, perfectly harmonizing with the overarching theme. The artistry is simply breathtaking, conveying a powerful sense of divinity while fitting seamlessly into the conceptual narrative. The lighting and sound design further elevate the atmosphere, creating a truly magical and memorable environment, particularly in the evening.
Despite being one of the most popular pujas in the area, the crowd is managed with remarkable efficiency by the organizers and local volunteers. The queues are orderly, and the entire process feels smooth and respectful, allowing everyone to enjoy the artistry without feeling overwhelmed.
In summary, Kashi Bose Lane is a must-visit for anyone who appreciates the creative spirit of Durga Puja. It is a brilliant showcase of community, culture, and artistic excellence. Highly recommended!

name: Gauri Bari Sarbojanin Durga Puja Pandal
description:
I am a Google Verified Local Guide. My name is Somnath Samanta.

North Kolkata's pujas are a blend of tradition and modernity, and 'Gouriberia Sarbojanin' has always been a shining star in that list. This famous club entered its 92nd year in 2025, and like every year, this time too they have won the hearts of the visitors.

The idea or theme of their puja this time was 'Soil and Life'. Artist Nikhil Mistri has successfully implemented this extraordinary idea. 'Soil and Life'—the name 'Soil and Life'—you can understand just by hearing it, it speaks of the roots of our existence. The use of soil in the decoration of the pavilion and the way the pulse of life has been brought out is, in a word, impeccable. Artist Nikhil Mistry has skillfully depicted the sweet smell of earth and the story of the primitive relationship between human life in every corner of the mandap. The aesthetics of the mandap and the use of lighting have given the atmosphere a different dimension, which makes the audience think.

The idols also had that touch of earth and a mix of modern art with the ancient. The entire atmosphere was decorated so beautifully that one can feel a strange tranquility as soon as one enters the mandap.

Special mention must be made of photographer Souvik Basak, who has wonderfully captured this beautiful moment and the details of the mandap decoration on his camera. His pictures have made the memory of this puja even longer.

All in all, Gauri Beriya Sarvajanin 2025 gave an unforgettable experience to the visitors. This mandap was one of the best destinations in the puja tour of North Kolkata. I look forward to such beautiful surprises in the coming year as well.

name: Raja Subodh Mallick Square Park
description:
Raja Subodh Mullick Square: A Powerful Ode to 'Nari Shakti'!
Raja Subodh Mullick Square Sarbojanin has delivered one of Kolkata Durga Puja 2025's most powerful and beautifully conceived themes: "Women’s Power (Nari Shakti)." This committee’s innovation is simply awesome.
The pandal is a stunning visual tribute, uniquely designed using Shakha Pola—the traditional red and white bangles—to celebrate the strength and sacrifice of Bengali married women. This theme successfully showcases how women are worshipped as divine, just like Durga herself.
The idol is unique in its own way, perfectly complementing the theme. This creative and meaningful display is a must-visit for pandal-hoppers, but be warned, the atmosphere is deservedly crowded! It is best to go ASAP to fully appreciate this thoughtful and innovative celebration of womanhood.
